name: Geared Up Apparel
old_description: “Not at all! We work with clients nationwide and offer reliable shipping anywhere in the U.S. Your custom order can be delivered directly to your door.”
about:
Geared Up Apparel operates from Elk River, Minnesota, as a family-driven, female-owned and operated small business. The company provides custom apparel and promotional products to clients nationwide, shipping anywhere in the United States.

The shop offers a range of decoration services including custom embroidery, screen printing, heat-seal printing, rhinestone and glitter application, and sublimated printing. It also sources promotional items such as jerseys, water bottles, stickers, pens, and chapstick. Digital mockups are provided for approval before production, and a one-time artwork fee applies for custom logo creation. The facility does not embroider leather or letterman jackets.

Geared Up Apparel serves small businesses, corporations, schools, athletic teams, associations, cities and counties, city services, and community members. Its embroidery work covers polos, dress shirts, jackets, hoodies, beanies, caps, medical scrubs, bags, joggers, and pants. The company also supports fundraising campaigns and local sponsorships.

The company emphasizes a clear, step-by-step process, relationship-based service, and fair pricing with exceptional value. Its stated mission is to create high-quality, fashionable custom apparel that fosters community and belonging, guided by values of creativity, integrity, and collaboration.

name: Gebco of Hawaii - A Division of IdentiSys
old_description: At Gebco Hawaii, we make it easy and simple to customize your corporate materials and signs to match your image.
about:
Gebco of Hawaii, a division of IdentiSys Inc., operates from Honolulu, Hawaii. The company has served the Hawaiian islands for over four decades, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. As part of IdentiSys—described as North America's largest full-service identification and security solutions provider—Gebco covers all major islands including Oahu, Maui, the Big Island, Kauai, Molokai, and Lanai.

The firm supplies and services a broad portfolio of identification, access control, and document-finishing equipment. Its offerings include ID card printers, access control and CCTV systems, laminating and binding machines, large-format poster printers, shredders, and food-service point-of-sale systems. Gebco also provides custom design services, on-site installation and maintenance, depot repair, and professional services such as card personalization and software integration.

Gebco serves a diverse set of verticals: corporate offices, educational institutions, financial services, gaming, government, healthcare, hospitality, industrial and manufacturing, membership and loyalty programs, retail, and transportation. Typical applications range from campus one-card programs and visitor management to patient identification, financial instant issuance, and asset tracking.

The division differentiates itself through its local presence across the entire state, backed by IdentiSys' nationwide service network. In 2023 it received a Vendor of the Year award for security cameras and access control, underscoring its focus on responsive support and customized solutions.

name: Gehl Food & Beverage - Southeast
old_description: Gehl Food & Beverage is located in Walterboro, South Carolina.
about:
Gehl Food & Beverage operates a 100,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Walterboro, South Carolina The site functions as the company's southeastern headquarters and production base, positioned to expand product capabilities toward the East Coast.

The plant currently runs two aseptic production lines dedicated to 1-liter Tetra Slim carton filling. Those lines support nutritional beverages, broth and stock, and plant-based beverage production. The building includes space for additional lines, with expansion planned for 2023 to accommodate growing demand in those categories.

The operation serves the food and beverage sector, specifically brands seeking aseptic co-packing in the Tetra Slim format for nutritional drinks, broths and stocks, and plant-based beverages. The facility's East Coast location is intended to shorten supply chains for customers in that region.

Gehl highlights its scalable aseptic capacity and strategic East Coast footprint as key advantages for partners looking to reach eastern U.S. markets without adding their own capital-intensive lines.

name: GenPro Energy Solutions
old_description: We design systems that maximize ROI with transparent pricing, tax credit guidance, and reliable performance.
about:
GenPro Energy Solutions is headquartered in Piedmont, South Dakota. The company was founded over two decades ago by Dwight Patterson in Rapid City, South Dakota, and remains privately held.

GenPro operates as a solar engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, delivering turnkey renewable energy projects including utility-scale solar arrays, community solar, battery storage, microgrids, and electrical and civil construction. The company manages projects ranging from 250 kW to 20 MW and employs over 110 skilled workers, reporting 224% revenue growth from 2022 to 2024.

Its clients span commercial, industrial, municipal, and utility sectors, with completed projects such as Long Meadow Dairy, Norfolk Community Solar, City of Schuyler Phase III Solar, and Clinton Solar 2B LLC.

GenPro emphasizes its roots in electrical craftsmanship, a workforce development program that pays significantly above regional averages, and a focus on mid-market solar projects. The company cites its NABCEP and OSHA certifications, multi-state licensing, and ten consecutive years on the Top 500 Solar Contractors list as differentiators.

name: Gene's Electronics
old_description: Special Offers for Seniors, Military and many front-line workers
about:
Gene's Electronics operates as an authorized DISH retailer from its location in Fort Kent, Maine. The company provides satellite television and broadband internet services to residents across the region, serving as a local point of sale and support for both product lines.

The business sells DISH programming packages—including America's Top 120, Top 200, and Top 250—bundled with the Hopper 3 whole-home DVR system. It also offers Starlink high-speed satellite internet plans. Services include free standard professional installation and 24/7 customer support. The Hopper 3 unit provides features such as automatic commercial skipping, multi-view recording, and up to 2,000 hours of storage.

Primary customers are residential households in rural and underserved areas, with specific promotions advertised for seniors, military personnel, and front-line workers. The company emphasizes its local presence and commitment to keeping communities connected through reliable signal delivery and a money-back guarantee on service reliability.

Gene's Electronics differentiates itself through consistent, reliable local service and a two-year price guarantee on DISH packages, positioning itself as a convenient alternative to national call centers. The shop also highlights the ability to switch TV packages anytime and includes local channels in every plan.

name: Genre Sports
old_description: Sublimation basketball jerseys with premium comfort, bold designs, and full team vibes.
about:
Genre Sports operates a sublimation, cut-and-sew factory in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company draws on over three decades of apparel manufacturing experience, including two decades running large garment factories overseas before establishing the Las Vegas facility.

The factory produces custom team uniforms and apparel — primarily sublimation-printed jerseys, shorts, and DTF transfers — for a range of sports including basketball, football, baseball, wrestling, and esports. Production runs through dye-sublimation printing, laser cutting of fabric panels, and commercial-grade sewing, with all stages controlled in-house.

Customers include wholesale distributors, school districts, community organizations, coaches, and businesses of all sizes. The company serves both team sports and individual athletes across more than a dozen sport categories, from volleyball and hockey to gymnastics and billiards.

Genre Sports emphasizes its Made-in-USA production, American labor, and direct factory pricing. It offers turnaround times from four days to four weeks, with same-day service available for DTF transfers, and provides an in-house design team, 3D preview tool, and mockup approval before manufacturing.

name: Georgia Electronic Design Center
old_description: The GEDC integrates, electronics, photonics, and AI/ML to enhance high-speed components and system
about:
The Georgia Electronic Design Center (GEDC) operates from Atlanta, Georgia, as part of the Georgia Institute of Technology. The center does not disclose a founding year or private ownership structure; it functions as a university-based research institute focused on electronics and photonics.

GEDC integrates electronics, photonics, and artificial intelligence/machine learning to advance high-speed components and system performance. Its core activities include multi-principal investigator sponsored research, industry engagement programs, and foundry access for prototyping. The center hosts more than 15 active faculty members and over 100 graduate and undergraduate students, making it one of the largest university-based semiconductor research centers in the world. Partners may establish design centers in Technology Square or within GEDC facilities to collaborate directly with researchers on directed projects.

The center serves industry partners across sectors that require high-speed electronic and photonic innovation, including semiconductor, telecommunications, and advanced computing. Companies engage through sponsored research agreements, consortium memberships, and direct collaboration with faculty and students to commercialize emerging technologies.

GEDC’s stated mission is to accelerate commercialization by transferring faculty and student innovations to industry through strong partnerships and consortia. It aims to empower partners to become technology leaders by providing prompt access to research breakthroughs and collaborative design infrastructure.

about:
Gieske Custom Metal Fabricators operates from Kansas City, Kansas, where it has been a fixture in metal fabrication for over a century. The company traces its roots to ventilation fabrication before expanding into a broad range of custom metalwork. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed, and ownership structure is not specified.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication, welding (TIG, MIG, and spatter), and precision cutting via fiber laser, waterjet, and plasma systems. It also offers metal polishing with brushed, mirrored, and angel hair finishes, along with sheet metal prototyping and OEM fabrication. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Customers include subcontractors, OEM and production firms, railroad companies, plant managers, and homeowners across the Greater Kansas City metro area, with select projects taken nationally. The company serves commercial, industrial, architectural, and ornamental metal fabrication needs.

Gieske emphasizes expertise, high quality, fast turnaround, and design capability as its differentiators, framing its mission around turning client visions into reality.

name: Gillette Steel Center
old_description: Committed to providing excellent customer service, superior steel products, and timely delivery.
about:
Gillette Steel Center was founded in 1991 by Blaine and Susie Wilson in Gillette, Wyoming. The couple started the business to meet the need for a reliable steel supplier in the Powder River Basin area.

The company operates as a full-service steel distributor with value-added processing. Its 30,000-square-foot warehouse and 6,000-square-foot office house over 3,500 tons of inventory, including structural steel (A36, A572-50, A633, T-1, Hardox), stainless steel, aluminum, and bar grating. Processing capabilities include CNC cutting, plate forming, shearing, sawing, fabrication, cut-to-length, burning, and 700-ton press work. Monthly shipments exceed 1,500 tons.

Gillette Steel serves customers across Northeast Wyoming and the broader Rocky Mountain region, with a 350-mile delivery radius reaching neighboring states. Its client base includes industrial and construction projects in the Powder River Basin, though specific industry sectors are not detailed publicly.

The company emphasizes same-day delivery for in-stock items and prompt scheduled deliveries, backed by a fleet of commercial trucks. It cites its legacy of quality, competitive pricing, and state-of-the-art equipment as key differentiators.
